Class ColumnUndoRedoEvent

java.lang.Object
java.util.EventObject
dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.EventObjectBacktrace
dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.ColumnUndoRedoEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
ChangeEventData, Serializable
public class ColumnUndoRedoEvent extends EventObjectBacktrace implements ChangeEventData
Sent by a component when value changes from undo/redo. The contents of the undo/redo stack is unchanged; note the error.
